newsitem.title: USA: Southern National to buy Craigie Inc.
newsitem.headline: Southern National to buy Craigie Inc.

text.p: Southern National Corp said Thursday it has an agreement to buy the investment banking firm Craigie Inc of Richmond, Virginia, for an undisclosed amount.
Southern said the boards of both companines have approved the agreement and the merger should be completed in the third quarter 1997.
Craigie has offices in Richmond and Charlotte, North Carolina, and originates, trades and distributes fixed-income securities and equity products in both the public and private capital markets.
Southern National, a multi-bank holding company, is the parent of Branch Banking & Trust Co and has $22.1 billion in assets.
